clue.text: University spoken highly of given a boost

parts.note: someone spoken highly of has been praised

explanation.surface: A college that is well reviewed gets a lift in standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lifted up or elevated has been given a boost, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Actor has power over film

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece placed over another comes first

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power
a film of dust or oil is a thin layer

explanation.surface: A performer holds sway over a movie production.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer on stage or screen is a player, as in 'the players' of a company.

clue.text: A young lady at fault

parts.note: Miss is the title of an unmarried young woman

explanation.surface: A girl is to blame for something.
explanation.definitionFit: When something has gone wrong or is faulty, it is said to be awry, out of order.

clue.text: Plant in river being cultivated by wise old president

parts.note: a sage person is wise

indicators.note: the river is held and tended within the wise old president, so it sits inside those letters

parts.note: Bush, either George H. W. or George W., former US president
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A shrub growing by a river, tended by an elderly sage former president.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant in river' reads as a place, but 'in' is only a link; the river letter goes into the president's surname.
explanation.definitionFit: This aromatic shrub of the North American West is a type of plant.

clue.text: Run down bottom of escarp in scrub

indicators.note: the picked letter is put inside the synonym for scrub

parts.note: to scrub a plan or text is to cancel or delete it

indicators.note: in a down entry the bottom of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone runs down the foot of a steep slope covered in scrubland.
explanation.definitionFit: To run down stocks or supplies is to use them up, to exhaust them.

clue.text: Reportedly one might provide alien craft?

indicators.note: signals that the word is heard rather than read, a sound-alike in non-rhotic speech

parts.note: someone who sources or supplies goods could jokingly be called a sourcer

explanation.surface: A rumour that someone could supply a spaceship from another world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reportedly' turns SOURCER, a made-up word for a supplier, into its sound-alike in British speech, where the R is silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A flying saucer is the classic UFO, so the shortened form stands for an extraterrestrial ship.

clue.text: Cancel boxing match?

definitions.meaning: to drop or abandon a plan
slang for a fight, the question mark hinting it is informal

explanation.surface: Calling off a prize fight.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to abandon something and, informally, a fight or scuffle.

clue.text: Like most police, kept in the dark when second note goes missing

indicators.note: the letter named is lost from the longer word

parts.note: someone kept in the dark has not been told, is ignorant
N is an abbreviation of note; 'second' says it is the second of the word's two N's

explanation.surface: The police mostly stay ignorant when a second memo vanishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Most police officers wear a standard outfit on duty, so they are dressed in regulation kit.

clue.text: Authorising woman to get jewellery

parts.note: Ena is a woman's name, a crossword favourite
bling is flashy jewellery, in slang

explanation.surface: Giving permission for a woman to acquire some jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: Empowering or permitting someone to act is a form of authorising them.

clue.text: Brave American lawyer taking on cartel

parts.note: DA, District Attorney, is a US public prosecutor
a ring is a group working together for illicit gain, like a cartel

explanation.surface: A courageous US prosecutor takes on a drug cartel.
explanation.definitionFit: Bold or adventurous is a close synonym of brave.

clue.text: Guerrilla with role in repressing South America

parts.note: an actor's role is a part

indicators.note: the word in holds down and encloses the abbreviation

explanation.surface: A rebel fighter plays a part in a crackdown on South America.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan is an irregular fighter resisting an occupying force, much like a guerrilla.

clue.text: European Union brought in right kind of fur that can be recycled

indicators.note: the union's letters are introduced into the other two pieces

parts.note: sable is a prized fur
EU is its abbreviation

explanation.surface: The EU has introduced the right sort of fur that can be recycled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fit to use again is suitable for recycling, the adjective covering both.

clue.text: East European keeps strange tailless dog

indicators.note: the European holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a Pole comes from Poland

indicators.note: the word for strange loses its final letter

parts.note: odd means strange

explanation.surface: A man from Eastern Europe owns an odd dog with no tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A poodle is a curly-coated breed of dog.

clue.text: Celebration of moving conflict between two dynasties

indicators.note: the conflict sits between the two dynasties

parts.note: a royal house (as in the House of Windsor) and the Ming dynasty of China
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: A historical war fought between two ruling families.
explanation.definitionFit: A party held when people move into a new home is this kind of celebration.

clue.text: Crew given fish as acknowledgment

parts.note: a ship's crew are its hands
hake is a sea fish

explanation.surface: Sailors are handed some fish in thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: Clasping hands is a gesture of greeting or agreement, a physical acknowledgment.

clue.text: A new suggestion — Italian wine that's served in trattoria

parts.note: a tip is a hint or suggestion
Asti is a sparkling wine from Piedmont

explanation.surface: A fresh tip: try the Italian wine they pour in the trattoria.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian starters are the dishes brought first in an Italian restaurant, a trattoria.

clue.text: A queen needing husband in inferior play

indicators.note: the three letters are put inside the word for inferior

parts.note: worse means of lower quality
R, for Regina, is the Latin abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: A queen requires a husband to appear in a second-rate drama.
explanation.definitionFit: An old, often-staged play or piece that is reliably revived is called a warhorse.

clue.text: At home during date, father cooked chicken

indicators.note: the letters for at home come within the mixed-up letters
food that is cooked is worked over, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: Dad cooked a chicken during a date at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' looks like the dish being cooked, but it is slang for cowardly; the rearranged letters are FATHEARTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken is slang for cowardly, lacking courage.

clue.text: Old car with restricted amount of actual leg room

indicators.note: only a limited portion of the phrase is used, the letters held inside it

explanation.surface: A vintage car with only a little legroom.
explanation.walkthrough: The Allegro was a 1970s British family car made by Austin.
explanation.definitionFit: The Austin model of the 1970s is a car no longer made, hence old.

clue.text: Vet show on TV

definitions.meaning: to check someone over for suitability

explanation.surface: A veterinary surgeon appears on a television programme.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to check candidates and to broadcast a programme.

clue.text: Chuck aunt and uncle finally avoiding relations

parts.note: Chuck and Chas are both short for Charles

indicators.note: takes the final letter of each of the two relatives

explanation.surface: Throw out your aunt and uncle to keep away from family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chuck' looks like a verb meaning throw, but it is a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone avoiding sexual relations is pure or celibate.

clue.text: Prepare article about Conservative government's rule

indicators.note: the first word goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: to prepare an article for print is to edit it

explanation.surface: Writing up a piece on Conservative policy.
explanation.definitionFit: A decree issued by an authority is an official order, a ruling from government.

clue.text: Slap on the mouth

parts.note: slap is British slang for make-up, so this is the make-up put on the lips, not a blow

explanation.surface: A smack across the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-up for the lips is a crayon-like cosmetic applied to them.

clue.text: It is not commonly a defect

parts.note: 'it' shortened to 't, as in 'tis
ain't is the non-standard, colloquial form of is not

explanation.surface: Someone protests that something is not usually a flaw.
explanation.definitionFit: A taint is a trace of contamination or a moral blemish, a flaw.

clue.text: Aspiration provides motivation embracing grand image of Oxford

parts.note: a dream is an ambition or aspiration

indicators.note: the word for motivating holds the letter inside it

parts.note: to inspire someone is to motivate them
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: An ambition motivates someone, who holds a grand picture of Oxford.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from Matthew Arnold's description of Oxford's skyline.
explanation.definitionFit: This poetic phrase is the stock picture of Oxford's college towers.

clue.text: See 23
This person overwhelmed by small amount of money gets stick

indicators.note: the coin's letters cover and surround the setter

parts.note: a cent is a small coin
the setter referring to themselves gives me

explanation.surface: The setter, crushed by a tiny sum, gets a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: To cement things is to bind them firmly, to make them stick together.

clue.text: Turn around keeping hand in skipping

indicators.note: the reversed word holds the other letters inside
the word for turn is read backwards

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game
mitt is slang for a hand

explanation.surface: Spinning round while keeping one's hand in the skipping rope game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipping' looks like part of the playground scene, but it is the definition, meaning leaving out; the reversed word is OG.
explanation.definitionFit: Skipping a passage is leaving it out, a synonym.
